description:
Aksum Orbit is a team of developers from Addis Ababa, who are beginning to work on a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive game for children to learn about how astronauts go through training. Our idea comes from the great engineering skills of the Aksum period from Ethiopia and the idea of space exploration in the future.

We are looking for people who love game development, web development, graphic design, animation, writing and storytelling.
